	focus = {
		id = COLDWAR_AFG_war_geneva
		icon = treaty4

		x = 6
		y = 4
		relative_position_id = COLDWAR_AFG_war_root

		cost = 5

		prerequisite = { focus = COLDWAR_AFG_war_refugees }

		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_COLDWAR_AFG_WAR }

		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_war_gate_tt
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt value = 25 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					has_war = yes
				}
			}
			country_exists = PAK
			NOT = { has_war_with = PAK }
			country_exists = SOV
			NOT = { has_war_with = SOV }
			country_exists = USA
			NOT = { has_war_with = USA }
		}

		completion_reward = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus COLDWAR_AFG_war_geneva"
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = PAK }
				PAK = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.132 days = 1 } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = SOV }
				SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.132 days = 1 } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = USA }
				USA = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.132 days = 1 } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_geneva_accords_open value = 1 days = 90 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_offer_geneva_accords_party = ruling_party }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_geneva_accords_refused
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			effect_tooltip = {
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_geneva_accords
				custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_geneva_effects_tt
				PAK = {
					add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_geneva_accords_partner
				}
				SOV = {
					add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_geneva_accords_partner
				}
				USA = {
					add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_geneva_accords_partner
				}
			}
		}

		ai_will_do = { base = 1 }
	}
